description.narrative: The Partos Innovationhub (formerly the Learning and Innovation Programme) supports innovators working within Dutch development organizations to develop new solutions for a just, inclusive and sustainable world. It does so based on three intervention strategies: connecting, agenda setting, and facilitating innovation labs. The focus is on change and innovation opportunities for civil society organizations in the Netherlands and their partners in the Global South, in four thematic areas: civic power, inclusion1, new ways of organizing and working together, and data and digital technology.The programme will operate based on a, regularly adapted, strategic agenda for collective learning and innovation. Moreover, it will be informed by the change that both Northern and Southern based civil society organizations see as relevant for resilient, inclusive and effective civil society partnerships,and inspired by lessons and innovations from innovators in global civil society and other sectors.
